provisions.policy_name: Removal of D/S References for F, J, and I Nonimmigrants
provisions.current_rule: References to D/S (duration of status) for F, J, and I nonimmigrants exist
provisions.proposed_rule: Striking all references to D/S for F, J, and I nonimmigrants
provisions.plain_english: All mentions of duration of status for F, J, and I visa holders will be removed.
provisions.evidence_quote: Striking all references to D/S for F, J, and I nonimmigrants;

provisions.policy_name: Admission requirements for F and J nonimmigrants
provisions.proposed_rule: Describing requirements for F and J nonimmigrants seeking admission, including after travel abroad and those approved for OPT and academic training
provisions.plain_english: New detailed admission requirements for F and J visa holders, including after travel and for those approved for Optional Practical Training and academic training.
provisions.evidence_quote: Describing requirements for F and J nonimmigrants seeking admission, including after travel abroad and those approved for OPT and academic training;

provisions.policy_name: Automatic extension visa validity provisions for F and J nonimmigrants
provisions.proposed_rule: Updating the cross reference and clarifying the standards for admission in the automatic extension visa validity provisions that cover F and J nonimmigrants applying at a port of entry (POE) after an absence not exceeding 30 days solely in a contiguous territory or adjacent islands
provisions.plain_english: Clarifies and updates rules allowing F and J visa holders to extend visa validity automatically when entering from nearby territories after a short absence.
restrictions: absence solely in a contiguous territory or adjacent islands
provisions.evidence_quote: Updating the cross reference and clarifying the standards for admission in the automatic extension visa validity provisions that cover F and J nonimmigrants applying at a port of entry (POE) after an absence not exceeding 30 days solely in a contiguous territory or adjacent islands;

provisions.policy_name: Process for Extension of Status (EOS) applications for F, J, and I nonimmigrants
provisions.proposed_rule: Outlining the process for EOS applications for F, J, and I nonimmigrants
provisions.plain_english: Provides specific procedures for applying to extend nonimmigrant status for F, J, and I visa holders.
provisions.evidence_quote: Outlining the process for EOS applications for F, J, and I nonimmigrants;

provisions.policy_name: Effect of departure while EOS application is pending for F and J nonimmigrants
provisions.proposed_rule: Specifying the effect of departure while an F or J nonimmigrant's application for an EOS in F or J nonimmigrant status and/or employment authorization (and an associated employment authorization document (EAD)) is pending
provisions.plain_english: Clarifies what happens if F or J visa holders leave the US before their extension of status and employment authorization applications are decided.
provisions.evidence_quote: Specifying the effect of departure while an F or J nonimmigrant's application for an EOS in F or J nonimmigrant status and/or employment authorization (and an associated employment authorization document (EAD)) is pending;

provisions.policy_name: Replacement of D/S with fixed time period admission for F, J, and I nonimmigrants
provisions.current_rule: Admission for F, J, and I nonimmigrants is tied to D/S
provisions.proposed_rule: Providing procedures specific to the transition from D/S to admission for a fixed time period of authorized stay for F, J, and I nonimmigrants
provisions.plain_english: Changes admission procedures from indefinite duration based on status to a fixed authorized time period for F, J, and I visa holders.
provisions.evidence_quote: Providing procedures specific to the transition from D/S to admission for a fixed time period of authorized stay for F, J, and I nonimmigrants;

provisions.policy_name: Replacement of specific form references with general language
provisions.current_rule: References to specific forms by name and number
provisions.proposed_rule: Replacing references to specific form names and numbers with general language, to account for future changes to form names and numbers
provisions.plain_english: Regulations will use general terms for forms instead of specific names/numbers to allow future flexibility.
provisions.evidence_quote: Replacing references to specific form names and numbers with general language, to account for future changes to form names and numbers.

provisions.policy_name: Authorized admission and extension periods for F and J nonimmigrants
provisions.proposed_rule: Setting the authorized admission and extension periods for F and J nonimmigrants up to the program length, not to exceed a 4-year period
provisions.plain_english: F and J visa holders can be admitted or extended for the length of their program but for no longer than four years.
requirements: Admission and extension up to program length
provisions.evidence_quote: Setting the authorized admission and extension periods for F and J nonimmigrants up to the program length, not to exceed a 4-year period;

provisions.policy_name: First academic year completion requirement before changing or transferring schools for F-1 students
provisions.proposed_rule: For F-1 students changing educational objectives or transferring to an SEVP-certified school, requiring that the student complete his or her first academic year of a program of study at the school that initially issued his or her Form I-20 or successor form, unless an exception is authorized by SEVP
provisions.plain_english: F-1 students must finish their first academic year at their initial school before they can change study objectives or transfer, unless SEVP allows an exception.
requirements: Complete first academic year at initial school unless SEVP authorizes exception
provisions.evidence_quote: For F-1 students changing educational objectives or transferring to an SEVP-certified school, requiring that the student complete his or her first academic year of a program of study at the school that initially issued his or her Form I-20 or successor form, unless an exception is authorized by SEVP;

provisions.policy_name: Prohibition on F-1 graduate students changing programs during study
provisions.proposed_rule: Prohibiting F-1 students at the graduate education level from changing programs at any point during a program of study
provisions.plain_english: Graduate-level F-1 students cannot change their academic programs once they start.
restrictions: No program changes allowed during graduate study
provisions.evidence_quote: Prohibiting F-1 students at the graduate education level from changing programs at any point during a program of study.

provisions.policy_name: Procedures for F-1 nonimmigrants changing educational objectives while in status
provisions.proposed_rule: Outlining procedures and requirements for F-1 nonimmigrants who change educational objectives while in F-1 status
provisions.plain_english: Specifies how F-1 students can change their educational goals while maintaining their visa status.
provisions.evidence_quote: Outlining procedures and requirements for F-1 nonimmigrants who change educational objectives while in F-1 status;

provisions.policy_name: Restriction on educational level changes for F-1 nonimmigrants
provisions.proposed_rule: Requiring any nonimmigrant who has completed a program at one educational level to only be allowed to begin another program at a higher educational level while in F-1 status and prohibiting a change to the same or a lower educational level while in F-1 status
provisions.plain_english: After finishing a program, F-1 students can only enroll in a higher degree program and cannot downgrade or enroll in the same level again.
requirements: New program must be at higher education level than completed program
restrictions: No change to same or lower educational level permitted
provisions.evidence_quote: Requiring any nonimmigrant who has completed a program at one educational level to only be allowed to begin another program at a higher educational level while in F-1 status and prohibiting a change to the same or a lower educational level while in F-1 status;

provisions.policy_name: Reduction of allowed departure preparation period for F-1 nonimmigrants
provisions.current_rule: 60 days allowed after completion of study or post-completion practical training to prepare to depart
provisions.proposed_rule: Decreasing from 60 to 30 days the allowed period for F-1 nonimmigrants to prepare to depart from the United States after completion of a course of study or authorized period of post-completion practical training
provisions.plain_english: F-1 students have 30 days instead of 60 to prepare to leave the US after finishing their studies or practical training.
provisions.evidence_quote: Decreasing from 60 to 30 days the allowed period for F-1 nonimmigrants to prepare to depart from the United States after completion of a course of study or authorized period of post-completion practical training;

provisions.policy_name: Biometric collection for EOS applications for F, J, and I nonimmigrants
provisions.proposed_rule: Providing for collection of biometric information in conjunction with an EOS application for F, J, and I nonimmigrants as may be required by 8 CFR 103.16
provisions.plain_english: Biometrics may be collected from F, J, and I visa holders applying for extension of status.
provisions.evidence_quote: Providing for collection of biometric information in conjunction with an EOS application for F, J, and I nonimmigrants as may be required by 8 CFR 103.16;

provisions.policy_name: Aggregate stay limit for language training students
provisions.proposed_rule: Limiting language training students to an aggregate 24-month period of stay, including breaks and an annual vacation
provisions.plain_english: Students in language training programs can stay for a total of 24 months maximum, counting breaks and vacations.
provisions.evidence_quote: Limiting language training students to an aggregate 24-month period of stay, including breaks and an annual vacation;

provisions.policy_name: Unacceptable reasons for F program extensions
provisions.proposed_rule: Providing that a delay in completing one's program by the program end date specified on the Form I-20, which includes but is not limited to delays caused by academic probation or suspension or a student's repeated inability or unwillingness to complete his or her course of study, generally is an unacceptable reason for program extensions for F nonimmigrants
provisions.plain_english: F students generally cannot get program extensions because of delays like academic probation or failure to complete courses.
restrictions: Delays from academic probation, suspension, or failure to complete course are unacceptable reasons for extension
provisions.evidence_quote: Providing that a delay in completing one's program by the program end date specified on the Form I-20, which includes but is not limited to delays caused by academic probation or suspension or a student's repeated inability or unwillingness to complete his or her course of study, generally is an unacceptable reason for program extensions for F nonimmigrants;

provisions.policy_name: Auto-extension of employment authorization for F nonimmigrants with pending EOS
provisions.current_rule: No specified auto-extension for expired employment authorization linked to pending EOS
provisions.proposed_rule: Allowing F nonimmigrants whose timely filed EOS applications remain pending after their admission period has expired to receive an auto-extension of their current authorization for on-campus and off-campus employment based on severe economic hardship resulting from emergent circumstances under existing 8 CFR 214.2(f)(5)(v). The length of the auto-extension of employment authorization would be up to 240 days or the end date of the Federal Register notice announcing the suspension of certain regulatory requirements, whichever is earlier
provisions.plain_english: F visa holders with pending extension applications can automatically extend their work permits for up to 240 days if facing severe economic hardship due to emergencies.
requirements: Severe economic hardship due to emergent circumstances
restrictions: Auto-extension limited to 240 days or Federal Register notice end date
provisions.evidence_quote: Allowing F nonimmigrants whose timely filed EOS applications remain pending after their admission period has expired to receive an auto-extension of their current authorization for on-campus and off-campus employment based on severe economic hardship resulting from emergent circumstances under existing 8 CFR 214.2(f)(5)(v). The length of the auto-extension of employment authorization would be up to 240 days or the end date of the Federal Register notice announcing the suspension of certain regulatory requirements, whichever is earlier;

provisions.policy_name: Replacement of D/S with fixed time period admission for I nonimmigrants with exceptions for PRC nationals
affected_groups: I aliens from People's Republic of China
provisions.current_rule: I nonimmigrants admitted with duration of status
provisions.proposed_rule: Replacing D/S for I nonimmigrants with admission for a fixed time period until they complete the activities or assignments consistent with the I classification, not to exceed 240 days (with the exception of some I aliens from the People's Republic of China), with an EOS available for I nonimmigrants who can meet specified EOS requirements
provisions.plain_english: I visa holders will get admission for a fixed time (up to 240 days) instead of duration of status, except some from China; they can apply to extend their status if eligible.
exceptions: Some I aliens from People's Republic of China
provisions.evidence_quote: Replacing D/S for I nonimmigrants with admission for a fixed time period until they complete the activities or assignments consistent with the I classification, not to exceed 240 days (with the exception of some I aliens from the People's Republic of China), with an EOS available for I nonimmigrants who can meet specified EOS requirements;

provisions.policy_name: Codification of foreign media organization definition for I status
provisions.proposed_rule: Codifying the definition of a foreign media organization for I nonimmigrant status, consistent with long-standing USCIS and DOS practice
provisions.plain_english: Formalizes the existing definition of foreign media organizations related to I visa classification.
provisions.evidence_quote: Codifying the definition of a foreign media organization for I nonimmigrant status, consistent with long-standing U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) and U.S. Department of State (DOS) practice;

provisions.policy_name: Updated evidence required for I nonimmigrant eligibility
provisions.proposed_rule: Updating the evidence an alien must submit to demonstrate eligibility for the I nonimmigrant classification
provisions.plain_english: Changes the documents required to prove eligibility for the I visa.
provisions.evidence_quote: Updating the evidence an alien must submit to demonstrate eligibility for the I nonimmigrant classification;

provisions.policy_name: Continued employment authorization for J-1 employment authorized status holders during pending EOS
affected_groups: J-1 nonimmigrants with employment authorized with a specific employer
provisions.current_rule: J-1 employment authorized can continue up to 240 days during pending EOS; J-2 lose work authorization when EAD expires
provisions.proposed_rule: Clarifying that J-1 nonimmigrants who are employment authorized with a specific employer incident to status, continue to be authorized for such employment for up to 240 days under 8 CFR 274a.12(b)(20) if status expires while their timely filed EOS application is pending, whereas J-2 dependents who must apply for employment authorization with an EAD do not have continued work authorization once the EAD expires
provisions.plain_english: J-1 visa holders with employer authorization can keep working up to 240 days after status expires if extension application is pending; J-2 dependents lose work authorization once their EAD expires.
restrictions: No continued authorization for J-2 after EAD expiration
provisions.evidence_quote: Clarifying that J-1 nonimmigrants who are employment authorized with a specific employer incident to status, continue to be authorized for such employment for up to 240 days under the existing regulatory provision at 8 CFR 274a.12(b)(20), if their status expires while their timely filed EOS application is pending, whereas J-2 dependents, who must apply for employment authorization as evidenced by an EAD, do not have the benefit of continued work authorization once the EAD expires;

provisions.policy_name: Employment continuation for I nonimmigrants with pending EOS
provisions.proposed_rule: Clarifying that I nonimmigrants are authorized to continue working in the United States for their foreign employer, under 8 CFR 274a.12(b)(20), while their timely filed EOS application is pending for up to 240 days (limited to 90 days for some PRC passport holders, excluding Hong Kong and Macau passport holders)
provisions.plain_english: I visa holders can keep working for their foreign employers for up to 240 days while waiting on extension approval; those with certain PRC passports get up to 90 days.
restrictions: Up to 240 days; 90 days for certain PRC passport holders
exceptions: PRC passport holders limited to 90 days except for HK and Macau passports
time_limits_or_durations: up to 90 days for select PRC nationals
provisions.evidence_quote:
Clarifying that I nonimmigrants are authorized to continue working in the United States for their foreign employer, under 8 CFR 274a.12(b)(20), while their timely filed EOS application is pending for up to 240 days; \22\
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
\22\ This time period is limited to up to 90 days for I nonimmigrants with a passport from the People's Republic of China but does not include those with a Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passport or a Macau Special Administrative Region passport.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

provisions.policy_name: Striking of all D/S and duration of employment references for F, J, and I classifications
provisions.current_rule: Regulations include references to 'duration of status' and/or 'duration of employment' for F, J, and I classifications
provisions.proposed_rule: Striking all references to 'duration of status' and/or 'duration of employment' for the F, J, and I nonimmigrant classifications
provisions.plain_english: Eliminates all mentions of duration of status or employment for these visa categories.
provisions.evidence_quote: Striking all references to “duration of status” and/or “duration of employment” for the F, J, and I nonimmigrant classifications;

provisions.policy_name: Severability clause for regulatory provisions
provisions.proposed_rule: Including a severability clause. In the event that any provision of this rule is not implemented for whatever reason, DHS proposes that the remaining provisions be implemented in accordance with the stated purposes of this rule
provisions.plain_english: If part of this rule is not implemented, the rest of the rule will still be enforced to meet its intended purpose.
exceptions: If any provision is not implemented
provisions.evidence_quote: Including a severability clause. In the event that any provision of this rule is not implemented for whatever reason, DHS proposes that the remaining provisions be implemented in accordance with the stated purposes of this rule.

provisions.policy_name: Establishment of period of stay for F or J nonimmigrants changing status prior to Final Rule
provisions.proposed_rule: Establishing requirements to determine the period of stay for F or J nonimmigrants whose change of status application was approved before the Final Rule's effective date and who depart the United States, then seek admission after the Final Rule's effective date
provisions.plain_english: Sets rules on how to determine the stay length for F and J visa holders who changed status before the new rule but leave and try to return after the rule takes effect.
provisions.evidence_quote: Establishing requirements to determine the period of stay for F or J nonimmigrants whose change of status application was approved before the Final Rule's effective date and who depart the United States, then seek admission after the Final Rule's effective date;

provisions.policy_name: Abandonment of change of status applications upon departure
affected_groups: F, J, and other nonimmigrants applying for change of status
provisions.proposed_rule: Codifying the long-standing policy under which DHS deems abandoned an application to change to another nonimmigrant status, including F or J status, if the alien who timely filed the application departs the United States while the application is pending
provisions.plain_english: If a person leaves the US while waiting on a pending change of status application (including F or J), that application is considered abandoned by DHS.
restrictions: Departure from the US while application pending leads to abandonment
provisions.evidence_quote: Codifying the long-standing policy under which DHS deems abandoned an application to change to another nonimmigrant status, including F or J status, if the alien who timely filed the application departs the United States while the application is pending.

provisions.policy_name: Updating employment authorization provisions to incorporate 8 CFR 214.2 revisions
affected_groups: All aliens authorized to accept employment
provisions.proposed_rule: Updating the employment authorization provisions to incorporate the revisions in 8 CFR 214.2
provisions.plain_english: Employment authorization rules are updated to align with the new changes made to rules for F, J, and I nonimmigrants.
provisions.evidence_quote: Amend 8 CFR 274a.12, Classes of aliens authorized to accept employment, by updating the employment authorization provisions to incorporate the revisions in 8 CFR 214.2.
